description: Serve a Jellyfin-compatible API surface plus UDP auto-discovery so stock Jellyfin clients (smart TV apps) find Mediarr on the LAN and play from it directly, including resume and watched state.
deviation_notes: Spec format is a classic FR list rather than story-shaped: this is protocol-compatibility work where the acceptance criterion is 'a third-party client behaves correctly', so numbered wire-level requirements are more falsifiable than user stories. Scope confirmed with the owner 2026-07-29: full browse + play + resume/watched state (not discovery-only; explicit owner direction now requires full reference-surface parity). Prior art read before speccing: the sister project at /media/daniel-bo/320GB (serve.py, 1643 LOC) implements ~45 endpoints and is currently the working server on this LAN.
